title: arthrocereus melanurus subsp. odorus
intro: Arthrocereus melanurus subsp. odorus, commonly known as Night-Blooming Cereus, is a cactus species known for its unique and fragrant flowers that bloom at night. This plant is used in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Arthrocereus melanurus subsp. odorus include sedative and anti-inflammatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. However, research on this plant is limited, and further studies are needed to confirm its efficacy and potential uses in medicine.
